For m≥4, a bounded symbolic 3- or 4-step case division leaves four oriented triangle step multisets (all actual faces) and four nonbacktracking quadrilateral patterns that give exactly U,V,W,R,S after cyclic ordering; U,V,W bound pairs of A/B triangles. The Z-valued edge cocycle α(+1)=1, α(+2)=2, α(+h)=−1 is closed on every face, nontrivial on the +1 Hamiltonian cycle, but zero on R,S. The F2 cocycle β supported on h-edges by vertex parity is closed and has β(R)=β(S)=1, proving each surviving cycle is nonzero pure order-two in H1(Klein;Z)=Z⊕Z/2. R has N and S has p distinct unoriented translates, yielding exactly 6m+3 carriers of minimum length four; no essential triangle. Independent enumerations at m=4,5,8,12,20 confirmed step patterns and counts; uniform symbolic argument supplies universal m≥4 scope.
